rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterising whether braking is needed and whether the vehicle performs it. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking behaviour itself as the subject of evaluation. H-1 establishes stopping in time to avoid collision as relevant, supporting the temporal aspect without importing sensing or controller mechanisms into P.
determining_elements: “The vehicle’s braking-behaviour state” directly concerns performance or omission of the manoeuvre required by the evaluation target.
“Situations where a braking maneuver is required to avoid a collision” is supported by H-1 and FR-7; the scope is not restricted to the single pedestrian example.
Whether braking occurs in time belongs to the braking phenomenon, supported by H-1’s failure to stop in time and FR-7.1’s braking-onset requirement.
The scope references operational situations involving obstacle detection, not detection processes, sensor failures, computation, communication, or controller internals as parts of P.
